chunks: They will say: 'O Lord, give him who has brought this upon us two times more the torment of Hell;'
ai.seo_question: Who do the people of Hell ask to increase their punishment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the psychological state of the damned who, overwhelmed by regret, attribute their downfall to the specific agent of their misguidance, thereby intensifying their own culpability. The plea for 'double punishment' reflects the principle of *Zayd al-'Adhāb* (increasing torment) for those who actively led others astray, emphasizing the gravity of the *Qā'id* (leader) in the hierarchy of Hell. This highlights the Shia emphasis on individual accountability (*'Adl*) while acknowledging the compounding effect of following false guides.
